subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC3 requires that the live_preview field on ICommonContentstackConfig allows preview context (live_preview/preview_hash) to flow through to Contentstack queries in setCommonConfig. The interface field was added to src/interface/contentstack.ts (lines 9-14), but setCommonConfig (lines 148-175) destructures only { referenceFieldPath, only, except } from config — the live_preview field is silently dropped and never forwarded to the query object. Without this, per-query preview context (e.g. preview_hash) cannot reach Contentstack, meaning linked/tabular references will not show draft values, failing the story's core description: 'linked/tabular references show draft values'.
issues.suggestedFix: In setCommonConfig, destructure live_preview from config and forward it to the query. The Contentstack SDK's Query/Entry objects accept preview context via query.addParam('live_preview', JSON.stringify(live_preview)) or by chaining the preview config. At minimum add: if (live_preview) { query.addParam('live_preview', JSON.stringify(live_preview)); }. Also add a unit test verifying that when live_preview is passed in the config, setCommonConfig forwards it to the query.

issues.description: The diff changes contentstack.Stack(options) to contentstack.Stack(options as any). This untyped any cast bypasses TypeScript strict compliance because the contentstack SDK types do not include live_preview. While the file has an eslint-disable for no-explicit-any at the top, the review criteria require no untyped any without an explanatory comment. The cast has no comment explaining why it is needed.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an explanatory comment next to the cast, e.g.: // contentstack SDK types do not include live_preview; cast is required until SDK types are updated. Alternatively, extend the SDK's StackConfig type via declaration merging instead of using as any.

issues.description: The third live-preview test ('should call setHost with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST...') uses jest.doMock inside the test body after a top-level jest.mock('contentstack', ...) already exists. While the test passes, this pattern is fragile — jest.doMock combined with jest.resetModules() inside an individual test can lead to inconsistent mock state across the suite if test ordering changes.
issues.suggestedFix: Move the jest.doMock into a beforeAll within a dedicated describe block for the setHost-priority test, ensuring the mock lifecycle is clearly scoped.
